hints.title: Cycle Contraction
hints.text: Notice that within any strongly connected component of focus points, magic flows to every node if any single node is powered.

hints.title: Condensed Acyclic Graph
hints.text: Condense all cycles into super-nodes to form a directed acyclic graph and determine which components receive flow.

hints.title: Zero In-Degree Components
hints.text: Components with zero in-degree that are not reachable from any crystal require an added rune.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Kosaraju's algorithm contracts strongly connected components into a DAG to count zero in-degree components without crystals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Cycles prevent simple topological sorting without component condensation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + m) memory for reversed graph and component labels.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that any zero-in-degree component in the condensed DAG requires an energy source.
